# Jesús Carlos Acosta Rocha

Jesús Carlos Acosta Rocha is an AI Engineer, technical founder, and software engineer who has built and operated production systems since 2018.
His work includes AI products for education and medicine, distributed systems, MLOps, search, observability, Kubernetes, AWS, and Azure.
This is his canonical personal website for publishing projects, professional experience, and technical writing about artificial intelligence engineering.
